start1052.configuration: stiff_target_v1 + real_v1 + augmented_active_v1 + kld_global_v1; static saved RGB; no known dock + best_cluster on

carry1051.configuration: exact v131 options and commands + best_cluster on

physical_sequence: if all offline gates pass, seed1052 start only once; if final error <=.25m, seed1051 full once; agent_lock and ugrp_session mandatory
gt_use: scoring only after off/on predictions close
pose_estimate: amcl_best_cluster_v1 in BOTH off and on
carry_metrics: report RMSE and pre-setdown error; no extra posthoc gate
physics_policy: exclusive agent_lock + ugrp_session; no concurrent ego-map physics; dev_light

likelihood_probe.GT_pose: first view truth; same fixed stationary hypothesis as original score; evaluation only
likelihood_probe.report: per-view GT/false and product over 6 views; compare same points/poses, no reselecting false peak

sensor_model: amcl_likelihood_field_v1 in BOTH off and on
detector_development: own RGB inspection only; no truth used for extraction or threshold selection; synthetic tests
association: Gaussian point range/bearing/width for paired jambs; Gaussian normal-distance/angle for partial floor edge; ML same hue candidates, no blue-region identity prior
missing: not negative evidence; no fabricated max range; independent color edges allowed when wall filter returns empty
random_component: fixed .05 mixture; uniform over 6m and 2pi (door also 1m width); adapter constants are not book defaults
